definition.def: If one thing incorporates another thing, it includes the other thing. [formal]
examples: The new cars will incorporate a number of major improvements. [VERB noun]

definition.def: If someone or something is incorporated into a large group, system, or area, they become a part of it. [formal]
examples: The agreement would allow the rebels to be incorporated into a new national police force. [be VERB-ed + into]
The party vowed to incorporate environmental considerations into all its policies. [VERB noun + into]

definition.def: Incorporated is used after a company's name to show that it is a legally established company in the United States. [US, business]
formed into a business company with legal status
examples: the Incorporated Society of British Advertisers
